verdict.rationale: Token2 provides scripts/tools for bulk enrollment into Entra ID (PowerShell/GraphAPI-based fido2_bulkenroll_entraid) with random PIN assignment and logging, plus an open-source fido2-manage CLI that can audit/export device info and relying parties to JSON/CSV — covering some pre-registration and inventory needs. However there is no evidence of a centralized admin console, org-wide key inventory database, or ongoing lifecycle tracking (issuance, revocation, replacement) beyond the Entra ID import/export scripts.  Missing for 10: a unified fleet-management dashboard, cross-directory (not just Entra ID) bulk provisioning, and lifecycle/revocation tracking across the organization.
